name: ITEAG — Développement
postCreateCommand: pip install --require-hashes -r requirements/dev.lock && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py seed_demo && python manage.py check
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'pgrep -f "manage.py runserver" >/dev/null || nohup python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000 >/tmp/iteag-runserver.log 2>&1 &'
